items.title: Charles Elgar Interview, 1958-05-27
items.q: Now, Bill Johnson's outfit was the first colored Dixieland outfit.

ctx.x: Now, Bill Johnson's outfit was the first colored Dixieland outfit. I can recall who came here. And they played at 8th Street Theater with Trixie Freganza.
Do you remember about what year that was? I know it's hard to think about exactly the year, but if you can remember about when, in relation maybe to the First World War. Was it before that?
